raw_block.rationale: Revise the exemption package as a coordinated dependency chain. The prior rule reader ignored the already-solved choice of exemption systems, emitted nonnumeric caps, and returned unrelated jurisdictions. The revised producer reads only provisions within the currently available systems, keeps coupled rule fields aligned, handles unlimited exemptions and per-debtor multiplication explicitly, and supplies both native formatters through declared skill dependencies.

reads.question: Use the current solved reasoning to identify the available exemption systems. Within only those systems, read every provision that expressly covers a category represented by a current asset, including a generally applicable any-property provision. Exclude provisions from every unavailable jurisdiction and exclude enabling, opt-out, marital, or definitional provisions that do not themselves exempt the asset. Return aligned arrays, literal citation strings, normalized category tokens matching the current asset-category vocabulary, numeric per-debtor caps, unlimited flags, and separate-per-debtor flags.
